page.title: Ebirikukwatanisa
page.intro: Kwatanisa akawunti zaawe z’okuranga. Abarikwebembera kuruga omu burango bwawe nibahika omu Beebembezi Bangye bonka, n'okushohoza n'omuhendo ahari buri kwebembera.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form neeyebembera omu Beebembezi Bangye, okukoresa buri izooba n‘omuhendo gwa buri kwebembera, n‘omutindo gw‘okwebembera ogurikugaruka kwoherezibwa aha LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Tihariho ekiteirweho aha saava egi hati

banner.connected: LinkedIn ekwataniise. Abarikwebembera nibatwarwa hati - orupapura oru nirugarurwaho omu kaanya kakye.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn tekateirweho aha server egi hati. Omutegyeki aine kwongyeraho ID y’omukozi wa LinkedIn app n’ekihama.

connect.title: Kwatanisa LinkedIn
connect.intro: Taaha omu akawunti LinkedIn erikureeberera oburango bwawe. Leadrat neeshoma akawunti zaawe z'okuranga zonka, Lead Gen Form neeyebembera n'embariirira y'okuranga, kandi neeyohereza okuhindura oku orikuhindura.
connect.need1: Omurimo aha akawunti y’okuranga LinkedIn (Omureeberezi nari ahaiguru).
connect.need2: Omurimo aha rupapura rwa kampuni orurikukwatanisa (Omutegyeki, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Omureeberezi nari Omucondoozi) - LinkedIn neeyenda ngu egabane abarikwebembera.
connect.need3: Ekibuuzo ky'enamba y'esimu aha Lead Gen Forms - abarikwebembera abataine namba y'esimu tibarikubaasa kwongyerwamu.

connection.autoRenews: Okutunga nikugaruka busya kyonka kuhitsya obwo

connection.confirmDisconnect: Okusharaho LinkedIn ? Okuteerana nikurekyera aho kandi obubonero bw’okutunga nibushazibwamu. Ebirikwebembera, emibaro n‘ekihandiiko ky‘emirimo nibibiikwa.
connection.noPermission: Noobaasa kureeba orupapura oru. Okugaita n'okuhindura ebitebeekanisiibwe nikyetengyesa orusa rwa "Manage Settings".
connection.fetchHint: Abarikwebembera abasya nibakyeberwa buri dakiika nkye kandi ebiro 7 ebirikuhererukayo nibigaruka byakyeberwa buri izooba, n‘ahabw‘ekyo tihaine ekirikubura. Koresa eki ahabw‘abarikwebembera kuruga otakakwataniise, nari kugaruka kureeba obwire (okuhitsya ebiro 90 omurundi gumwe). Leads ezibaire ziri omu Leadrat nizijumbura.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Gambira LinkedIn ngu n’oha omu beebembezi baayo owaahindukire amatsiko gaabuzima. Omwebembezi wa LinkedIn ku arikuhika aha mwanya ogu orikutoorana ahaifo, Leadrat naakimanyisa LinkedIn , n’ahabw’ekyo ripoota zaawe za kampeyini nizooreka omutindo gw’omwebembezi kandi LinkedIn neebaasa kutunga abantu baingi nk’abeebembezi baawe abarungi. ID y’okwebembera LinkedIn yonka hamwe na hash y’omuringo gumwe eya email nibyoherezibwa.
capi.created: Okuhindura okukozirwe aha LinkedIn kandi kuhandiikirwe aha maapu.

activity.title: Ekihandiiko ky'emirimo
activity.intro: Buri kimwe ahagati ya Leadrat na LinkedIn : enkwatanisa, buri kuhikaana, buri kwebembera n’ekyahikireho, okuhindura n’enshobi.
